description: TCGA-BRCA breast invasive carcinoma cohort. One row per tumor sample with clinical, demographic, and selected molecular features. Illustrative asta-format metadata for the autodiscovery_rl example; the real CSV lives on the reward server side only.

datasets.name: tcga_breast_cancer.csv
datasets.description: One row per breast-cancer tumor sample with de-identified clinical and molecular annotations.

raw.name: sample_id
raw.description: De-identified unique identifier for the tumor sample.

raw.name: age_at_diagnosis
raw.description: Patient age in years at initial pathologic diagnosis.

raw.name: sex
raw.description: Reported sex of the patient (categorical: female, male).

raw.name: ajcc_stage
raw.description: AJCC pathologic tumor stage (categorical: Stage I, Stage II, Stage III, Stage IV).

raw.name: er_status
raw.description: Estrogen receptor status by IHC (categorical: positive, negative, indeterminate).

raw.name: pr_status
raw.description: Progesterone receptor status by IHC (categorical: positive, negative, indeterminate).

raw.name: her2_status
raw.description: HER2/neu receptor status (categorical: positive, negative, equivocal).

raw.name: pam50_subtype
raw.description: PAM50 intrinsic molecular subtype (categorical: LumA, LumB, Her2, Basal, Normal).

raw.name: tmb
raw.description: Tumor mutational burden in mutations per megabase.

raw.name: overall_survival_months
raw.description: Overall survival time in months from diagnosis.

raw.name: vital_status
raw.description: Vital status at last follow-up (categorical: alive, dead).
